declarations.description:
A window inside the page that the user drags, resizes, minimises and maximises: a support chat, an inspector beside
a canvas, a tool palette, a call's mini window. It is not modal; the page around it stays usable.

CSS sets where the panel first appears and how big it is (`--c2-floating-panel--inset`, `--width`, `--height`, the
bottom-right corner by default). Once the user moves or resizes it, `rect` holds the result, and `storage-key`
keeps it, with the state, in `localStorage`. `boundary="viewport"` (the default) keeps the panel inside the window
with `position: fixed`; `boundary="parent"` keeps it inside its nearest positioned ancestor, for a panel inside an
editor area. The panel always stays inside its boundary, also when the boundary or the window is resized.

Drag the title bar to move the panel (a double-click maximises and restores it), and an edge or a corner to resize
it. With the keyboard, the title bar is a handle: the Arrow keys move the panel by 10px (Shift: 50px) and Home puts
it back at its CSS place; the grip in the bottom-right corner resizes it the same way. Escape restores a maximised
panel and never closes it. Minimising docks the panel to the bottom edge of its boundary as a title bar (several
line up from the right), or with `minimize="collapse"` folds it to its title bar where it is. A press or focus
anywhere in a panel brings it in front of the other panels in the same boundary.

The host is `display: contents` and the component writes nothing on it: the panel is a non-modal `role="dialog"`
section in the shadow root named by its title (or `label`), and the host's own state shows as custom states.

cssProperties.description: Where the panel first appears in its boundary, as an `inset` shorthand: the bottom-right corner by default.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--inset

cssProperties.description: First width, before the user resizes the panel.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--width

cssProperties.description: First height, before the user resizes the panel.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--height

cssProperties.description: Smallest width a resize reaches.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--min-width

cssProperties.description: Smallest height a resize reaches.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--min-height

cssProperties.description: Largest width, a share of the boundary.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--max-width

cssProperties.description: Largest height, a share of the boundary.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--max-height

cssProperties.description: Stacking order of the panel at the back; each panel in front of it in the same boundary adds 1.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--z-index

cssProperties.description: Minimise, maximise and restore animate over this. No animation under reduced motion.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--transition-duration

cssProperties.description: Text colour of the body.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--color

cssProperties.description: Shadow of the panel in front.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: Shadow of a panel behind another one.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__inactive--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: Title of a panel behind another one.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__title__inactive--color

cssProperties.description: Width and height of each window button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__button--size

cssProperties.description: Resting opacity of the corner grip; it shows on hover, focus and on devices without hover.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__grip--opacity

cssProperties.description: Thickness of the invisible resize handles on the edges and corners.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__handle--size

cssProperties.description: Where the first docked panel sits; the next ones line up to its left.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__docked--inset

cssProperties.description: Space between docked panels.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__docked--gap

cssProperties.description: Space a maximised panel leaves around it in its boundary.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__maximized--inset

cssProperties.description: Focus ring of the handle, the grip and the window buttons.
cssProperties.name: --c2-floating-panel__focus--outline

cssParts.description: The draggable, focusable part of the title bar around the icon and the title.
cssParts.name: handle

cssParts.description: The Minimise button, which reads Restore while the panel is minimised.
cssParts.name: minimize-button

cssParts.description: The Maximise button, which reads Restore while the panel is maximised.
cssParts.name: maximize-button

cssParts.description: The scrolling body region around the default slot, which projects the panel's content inside it.
cssParts.name: body

cssParts.description: The resize grip in the bottom-right corner.
cssParts.name: grip

slots.description: The title, shown in the title bar; it names the panel. Falls back to `label`.
slots.name: title

slots.description: Extra title-bar buttons, before the window buttons.
slots.name: actions

slots.description: A row under the body, such as a message input.
slots.name: footer

members.name: stacks
members.description: Panels in front order (last is in front), per boundary: `document` for the window, else the positioned parent.

members.name: docks
members.description: Docked panels per boundary, in the order they docked: the first sits at the right.

members.name: msg
members.description: The buttons' names and announcements in the nearest `lang` (English, or a language the app adds).

members.name: open
members.description: Shows the panel. `show()` also moves focus into it; setting `open` does not.

members.name: state
members.description: `normal`, `minimized` or `maximized`. Setting it fires no `state-change`; `minimize()`, `maximize()` and `restore()` do.

members.name: boundary
members.description: `viewport` keeps the panel inside the window (`position: fixed`); `parent` inside its nearest positioned ancestor (`position: absolute`).

members.name: rect
members.description:
The panel's place and size, `{ x, y, width, height }` in boundary pixels, or `null` while it sits at its CSS place.
Set by the user's moves and resizes. A JSON attribute, to restore a saved place.

members.name: storageKey
members.description: When set, `rect` and `state` are kept in `localStorage` under this key and restored when the panel loads.

members.name: minimizeMode
members.description: `dock` moves a minimised panel to the bottom edge of its boundary; `collapse` folds it to its title bar where it is.

members.name: label
members.description: The panel's accessible name, and the visible title when the `title` slot is empty. Use it when the title is not text.

members.name: noDrag
members.description: The title bar does not move the panel.

members.name: noResize
members.description: The edges and the grip do not resize the panel.

members.name: noMinimize
members.description: No Minimise button.

members.name: noMaximize
members.description: No Maximise button, and a double-click on the title bar does nothing.

members.name: noClose
members.description: No Close button.

members.name: titleText
members.description: The title's text, for the handle's and the grip's names. Read on the client only, after the first render.

members.name: front
members.description: In front of the other panels of its boundary. True until the stack says otherwise, as the server renders it.

members.name: collapseAnchor
members.description: Where a collapsed panel at its CSS place folds, so it folds where it is rather than where `inset` anchors it.

members.name: hydrating
members.description: Rendered from a declarative shadow root: the light DOM is read only after hydration.

members.name: show
members.description: Opens the panel, brings it to the front and moves focus into it: its first focusable element, else the title bar.

members.name: close
members.description: Closes the panel unless a `before-close` listener cancels it. Focus returns to where it was before `show()`.

members.name: minimize
members.description: Minimises the panel: docked to the bottom edge, or collapsed to its title bar with `minimize="collapse"`.

members.name: maximize
members.description: Makes the panel fill its boundary, less `--c2-floating-panel__maximized--inset`.

members.name: restore
members.description: Returns a minimised or maximised panel to its place: a panel minimised while maximised goes back to maximised.

members.name: bringToFront
members.description: Puts the panel in front of every other panel in the same boundary.

members.name: moveTo
members.description: Moves the panel's top-left corner to `x`, `y` in boundary pixels, kept inside the boundary.

members.name: resizeTo
members.description: Resizes the panel to `width` by `height`, within its minimum, its maximum and the boundary.

members.name: resetRect
members.description: Puts the panel back at its CSS place and size (`rect` becomes `null`).

members.name: boundaryElement
members.description: The element whose padding box the panel lives in for `boundary="parent"`: the nearest positioned ancestor.

members.name: measure
members.description: The panel's place on screen in boundary pixels.

members.name: baseRect
members.description: The rect the user's next move starts from: the stored one, the collapsed anchor, or what is on screen.

members.name: keepInside
members.description: Pulls a placed panel back inside its boundary after the boundary, the window or `rect` changed.

members.name: animateFrom
members.description: Animates the panel from where it was to where it is now: a scale and a slide, skipped under reduced motion.

members.name: syncGroups
members.description: Joins or leaves its boundary's stack and dock, and watches the boundary's size while open.

members.name: bodyHasFocus
members.description: Whether focus is in the body or the footer, which a minimised panel hides.

events.name: rect-change
events.description: The panel's place or size changed: at the end of a drag or a resize, on a key press, when the boundary pushed it back inside (`reason: "boundary"`) or from a method. `detail.rect` is `null` when it went back to its CSS place. Does not bubble.

events.name: state-change
events.description: The user or a method minimised, maximised or restored the panel; `detail` is `{ state, previous }`. Not fired when script sets `state`. Does not bubble.

events.name: open
events.description: The panel opened (`open` became true after the first render). Does not bubble.

events.name: close
events.description: The panel closed. Does not bubble.
Cancelable: the user, or `close()`, is about to close the panel. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it open, for "Discard the draft?". Does not bubble.
events.name: before-close
